data.summary: In 2016, Elon Musk said something that might surprise you today: “Our philosophy with respect to service is not to profit from service. I think that it's terrible to make a profit on service.” By 2024, however, it appears that things are going the other way. As Electrek’s Fred Lambert reports, a significant portion of Tesla’s revenue comes from auto repairs, components and its network of Superchargers – exactly the sectors Musk had insisted would not be centered on profit.
